description: This file contains the implementation of a membership table for Orleans using Apache Zookeeper for coordination. It manages silo membership entries, their states, and versioning, utilizing Zookeeper nodes for storing and updating silo information atomically. The class includes methods for initializing the table, reading individual or all entries, inserting, updating, and deleting silo membership data, as well as handling Zookeeper interactions and serialization.

classes.name: ZooKeeperBasedMembershipTable
classes.description: Implements Orleans IMembershipTable interface using Apache Zookeeper for storing and managing silo membership data, including initialization, read, insert, update, and delete operations with atomicity and version control.

classes.name: ZooKeeperWatcher
classes.description: A watcher class for Zookeeper events, primarily used for debugging and logging watched events.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the Zookeeper-based membership table, creating the cluster path if it does not exist.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads membership data for a specific silo atomically.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Attempts to insert a new silo membership entry atomically, updating the table version.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Attempts to update an existing silo membership entry atomically, with version checks.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive status for a silo without changing the table version.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all entries for a specified cluster ID.

methods.name: TryTransaction
methods.description: Executes a transaction with Zookeeper, handling common exceptions for atomic operations.

methods.name: GetRow
methods.description: Retrieves a membership entry and its version for a specific silo.

methods.name: ConvertToRowPath
methods.description: Converts a SiloAddress to its corresponding Zookeeper node path.

methods.name: ConvertToRowIAmAlivePath
methods.description: Converts a SiloAddress to its IAmAlive node path.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes an object to a UTF8 JSON byte array.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a UTF8 JSON byte array to an object.
